14 July 2026 · Online community program attended

Sociapi Summer Bootcamp 2026

Launched by Sociapi Society on 14 July 2026, this six-week online learning program brought together students and young professionals from across Pakistan. Expert-led sessions covered Artificial Intelligence, LinkedIn and personal branding, IELTS preparation, and digital earning, with instruction from Engr. Iraj Shahzad, Abdul Wahab, Danial Yousufzai, and Neelum Javed. The bootcamp reflects Sociapi Society's commitment to accessible learning and future-ready skills.
